scenes.justification: Hook topology uses conversational chat bubbles between novice and mentor to bust the savings myth

beats.visualIntent: Alex's question about whether savings in cash truly grow appears as chat bubble 1
Dr. Rivera responds that inflation silently eats purchasing power in chat bubble 2
Alex acknowledges the hidden danger of losing real ground in chat bubble 3
Dr. Rivera welcomes Alex to Money That Grows and introduces nominal vs real return in chat bubble 4

scenes.justification: Comparison topology pits headline quoted APR against actual effective APY side by side

beats.visualIntent: Introductory comparison header sets up headline rate vs true annual yield
Left side shows APR before intra-year compounding, right side shows APY including compounding
Highlighting the monthly compounding gap between 12% APR and 12.68% APY

scenes.justification: Pillars topology displays four distinct financial superpowers progressively

beats.visualIntent: First card illuminates: Compound Interest calculation
Second card illuminates: Quoted APR vs True APY comparison
Third card illuminates: Rule of 72 doubling shortcut
Fourth card illuminates: Real Purchasing Power after inflation

scenes.justification: Roadmap topology displays the curriculum flow across modules and chapters

beats.visualIntent: Overview map of the entire course curriculum appears
Module 1 lights up with Chapter 1 (interest basics) and Chapter 2 (rates and Rule of 72)
Module 2 lights up with Chapter 3 (inflation and real returns) leading to synthesis

scenes.justification: Formula topology breaks down exponential compounding equation A = P(1+r)^t

beats.visualIntent: Master compounding formula A = P(1+r)^t appears centered in gold
Labels connect to each variable: P as principal, r as rate, t as time
Worked steps for 1,000 dollars at 5% show 1,050, 1,102.50, and 1,157.63 dollars
Comparison callout highlights 7.63 dollars in interest on interest

scenes.justification: Quiz topology engages the learner in independent verification of compounding mechanics

beats.visualIntent: Multiple-choice question displays 4 options on compounding behavior
Timer animation triggers for thinking phase pause
Correct option B highlights in green with explanation that interest earns interest

scenes.justification: Summary topology presents the eight reader commandments in six sequential beats

beats.visualIntent: Header card introduces the eight reader commandments thread
Cards 1 and 2 appear: definition of interest and principal
Cards 3 and 4 appear: compounding acceleration and time requirement
Cards 5 and 6 appear: APR vs APY distinction and Rule of 72
Cards 7 and 8 appear: inflation impact and real returns priority
All eight cards displayed simultaneously with transition callout to Chapter 1
